career_ladder.note: Engineer Trainees at THDC India Limited undergo 1 year of training in IDA Grade E-2 before absorption as Senior Engineer in IDA Grade E-3, advancing through THDC's executive promotion framework across hydro, thermal, wind, and solar power projects.

steps.source_label: THDC Recruitment Notification for Engineer Trainees through GATE
THDC Executive Service Regulations (Cadre Absorption Norms)

exam_scheme.note: Selection of Engineer Trainees is based on valid normalized GATE scores (85% weightage), Group Discussion (5% weightage), and Personal Interview (10% weightage). Qualifying in the interview is mandatory.

stages.source_label: THDC Advt. No. 01/2023 Selection Process and Weightage Criteria

papers.paper_name: GATE Examination in Relevant Engineering Discipline (CE/EE/ME/CS)
papers.negative_marking: Per standard GATE examination deduction rules
papers.qualifying_threshold: Shortlisting ratio 1:5 based on normalized GATE marks

stages.source_label: THDC GD and Personal Interview Criteria

financial_package.note: Engineer Trainees receive basic pay ₹50,000 in IDA Grade E-2 during training, plus 58% IDA constant as of 2025-07-01, hydro project allowances, company accommodation/HRA (up to 27%), and cafeteria perks (35%). On absorption in Grade E-3, basic pay advances to ₹60,000.
financial_package.pay_level: IDA Grade E-2 during training (₹50,000 – ₹1,60,000); Grade E-3 on regularisation (₹60,000 – ₹1,80,000)
financial_package.pay_source_label: THDC Remuneration and Service Benefits Schedule for Engineer Trainees
financial_package.estimate_note: Calculated with training Basic Pay ₹50,000, 58% IDA (₹29,000), HRA (up to 27% = ₹13,500), and Cafeteria Perks @ 35% (₹17,500), less statutory deductions for PF and Insurance.
official_perks: Industrial Dearness Allowance (IDA) revised quarterly per AICPI
Power plant township residential accommodation or House Rent Allowance (HRA)
Cafeteria allowances up to 35% of basic pay
Project allowance / special remote area allowance for Tehri/Koteshwar project sites
Comprehensive medical treatment for employee and dependent family members in project hospitals
Contributory Provident Fund, Gratuity, and Post-Retirement Medical Care
